title: RL-100

device.name: RL-100
device.type: Radar level sensor (continuous level measurement, liquids and bulk solids)

scope.boundary: The RL-100 device itself (standard and ATEX Zone 2 variants). Connected external systems are out of TRA scope but appear in the DFD as external entities.
inScope: Communication stack: 4-20 mA, HART, Modbus RTU/RS-485, Ethernet service interface, USB-C service interface

intendedUse: Continuous level measurement of liquids and bulk solids in industrial tanks and silos for process automation (chemical, food & beverage, water/wastewater, pharmaceutical, tank farms), including a SIL-certified safety-related measurement function, and local commissioning/configuration/diagnostics/firmware updates via the Ethernet service interface, which is for local access only and is not connected to the plant network.
foreseeableUse: The Ethernet or USB-C service interface being left connected for extended periods beyond a single maintenance session, rather than only during active commissioning/service.
Brief operation outside the specified environmental limits (e.g. beyond -40 degC to +80 degC, or splashing/immersion beyond IP67) during transport, storage, or installation.
